## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Engine / provider integration
- [ ] Reverse & Rust
- [ ] UI
- [ ] Docs / repository
- [ ] Refactor (no behaviour change)

## Verification

- [ ] `node test/run.mjs` passes
- [ ] New/updated tests cover the change
- [ ] UI checked at normal and narrow widths (if UI changed)
- [ ] `cargo check` / `cargo test` run for Rust changes (if applicable)
- [ ] No secrets, local paths, run data or generated files committed
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/*`, `CHANGELOG.md`)

## Notes for reviewers

Anything risky, deliberately not done, or needing a follow-up.
